# Orb-Ed

> Orb-Ed is an online learning platform for O Level, AS Level, A2 Level, IGCSE, and MDCAT students in Pakistan, offering recorded video lectures, past paper practice, and 24/7 tutor support to students anywhere in the country — including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Gujranwala, Sialkot, Peshawar, and Hyderabad.

## Courses

- [O Level, A Level & IGCSE Courses](https://orb-ed.pk/courses.php): Full subject catalogue across O Level, AS Level and A2 Level — Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Business Studies, Computer Science, Psychology, Law, Islamiyat, Pakistan Studies, English, Urdu (including Urdu IGCSE) — plus subject bundles and Skill Development courses.
- [Economics Course Detail](https://orb-ed.pk/economics.php): O Level Economics course structure and content.
- [About Orb-Ed](https://orb-ed.pk/aboutus.php): What Orb-Ed offers and why students choose online learning over traditional tuition centres.
- [Study Abroad Services](https://orb-ed.pk/studyabroad.php): Assessments, scholarships, visa guidance and test prep for students applying to universities abroad.
